filesystem.description: Access dependency files (package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, pom.xml, go.mod), lock files, and configuration files for reading and updating

github.description: Create dependency update PRs, manage Dependabot alerts, review security advisories, and track CI/CD results for dependency changes
github.setupInstructions: Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable with a token that has repo, security_events, and workflow scopes

context7.description: Query package registries (npm, PyPI, crates.io, Maven Central), fetch CVE/vulnerability data, retrieve package metadata, changelogs, and license information
context7.setupInstructions: Sign up at https://context7.com and set CONTEXT7_API_KEY environment variable

fetch.description: Fetch data from package registry APIs, security advisory databases (OSV, Snyk, GitHub Advisory), package statistics, and SBOM sources

securityAudit.description: Perform comprehensive security audit of dependencies
steps: Use filesystem MCP to read package manifest files (package.json, requirements.txt, etc.)
Use filesystem MCP to read lock files for exact version information
Use context7 MCP to query vulnerability databases for each package
Use fetch MCP to retrieve additional CVE data from OSV and GitHub Advisory
Use github MCP to check for existing Dependabot alerts
Generate audit report with severity levels and remediation steps

dependencyUpdate.description: Safely update dependencies with testing and PR creation
steps: Use filesystem MCP to read current dependency versions
Use context7 MCP to fetch latest versions and changelogs from registries
Use fetch MCP to check package download statistics and community health
Use filesystem MCP to update package files and lock files
Run tests via bash to verify compatibility
Use github MCP to create pull request with detailed changelog
Use github MCP to monitor CI/CD pipeline status

dependencyAnalysis.description: Analyze dependency tree for optimization opportunities
steps: Use filesystem MCP to read all dependency files in monorepo
Use context7 MCP to fetch package metadata including bundle sizes
Use fetch MCP to query bundlephobia for size analysis
Identify duplicates, unused packages, and circular dependencies
Generate visualization and optimization recommendations
Calculate potential bundle size reduction
Use filesystem MCP to read dependency manifests
Use context7 MCP to fetch license information for each package
Use fetch MCP to retrieve license texts and compatibility data
Check against organizational license policies
Generate compliance report with flagged packages
Suggest alternative packages if needed

supplyChainSecurity.description: Verify package integrity and supply chain security
steps: Use filesystem MCP to read lock files with checksums
Use fetch MCP to verify package signatures from registries
Use context7 MCP to check for known supply chain attacks
Use github MCP to review package source repositories
Check for typosquatting and dependency confusion risks
Generate supply chain security report
